title: oxylobium heterophyllum
intro: Oxylobium heterophyllum, commonly known as the New Zealand oak, is a small tree or shrub native to New Zealand. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, helping to reduce pain and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of Oxylobium heterophyllum include its ability to act as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent, making it useful in treating wounds and skin conditions. However, the bioactive constituents of this plant have not been extensively studied, and more research is needed to fully understand its properties and effects.
